tools.name: ask_hirepulse_advisor
tools.description: Free advisor that maps B2B leads, hiring signals, buying intent, tech stack, Google Ads and due diligence goals to a tool, price, free-call balance and ready-to-run request preview. For unclear tool choice or cost; get_company_profile provides a full brief for a known domain. Includes four n8n recip

tools.name: detect_website_tech_stack
tools.description: Website tech stack lookup from a domain (BuiltWith-style technographics): ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok), analytics, tag managers, CMS, e-commerce platform, hosting, payments, plus email provider, SPF and DMARC from DNS. Use when an agent needs technographic data for lead enrichment

tools.name: get_company_open_jobs
tools.description: Company job postings lookup from a domain: open roles from public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters boards, with title, department, location, remote flag and published salary; up to 300 jobs, and new or closed jobs against known_job_ids. Use when an agent needs open r

tools.name: get_company_hiring_intent
tools.description: Hiring intent score (0-100) for a company domain, from its public job board: hiring status, open roles, postings in the last 30 days, functions and technologies. A heuristic signal, not confirmed purchase intent. Use when an agent ranks accounts by hiring activity. $0.01; no board or no jobs is free

tools.name: get_google_ads_by_domain
tools.description: Google Ads lookup for a company domain from the public Ads Transparency Center: advertiser status, estimated ad count and up to 40 ads with format, dates and links; optional region filter. Use when an agent researches a company's or a competitor's advertising. No private account access. $0.01; no ad

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Company profile and B2B lead enrichment: tech stack, hiring intent, Google Ads, published contacts and breakout_summary growth estimates. $0.03 only when2+ of4 sections have data; one of 10 free calls/day. Estimates are not forecasts. Use individual tools for one signal; bulk and footprint research

tools.name: watch_company_jobs
tools.description: Job-change monitoring for up to 50 company domains: with known_job_ids per domain from an earlier answer, returns only new and closed jobs. The scan is free and returns a quote_id; $0.01 is charged only per company whose jobs changed or that needs a first baseline, at most $0.50. Unchanged companies

tools.name: extract_company_contacts
tools.description: Company contact lookup from a domain: published emails and LinkedIn, X and GitHub links from the home, about, contact, team and careers pages, deduplicated, plus MX, SPF and DMARC records. Not mailbox verification. Use when an agent needs public company contact data for outreach research. $0.01; not

tools.name: claim_free_trial
tools.description: One-time pass: 25 successful calls shared across supported single-domain tools, valid 30 days and independent of IP. Excludes private lookup, quote redemption and paid email inboxes. Takes one active Base wallet or a work email (no email is sent). The pass goes in the X-Trial-Token header or MCP met
